narr: Deep monsoon moisture over easern Arizona allowed at least one thunderstorm with heavy rain to form over the Little Colorado River basin above St Johns.
ev: Heavy rain caused an incrase in the water flowing down the Little Colorado River near St Johns. The flow started to incrase at 1500 and peaked at around 2 feet higher at 1700. The river dropped back to near normal at 2100.
lsr: A USGS river gauge on the Little Colorado River near St Johns (LCSA3) reported a 2.03 foot rise from nearby thunderstorms.
